scientific_integrity: Analytical argument is self-contained. Originality requires human publication-priority review; the relevant 2015 carrying-capacity paper was not available in full text. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected undirected weighted networks; strictly positive growth rates; identical quadratic self-limitation; local positive-equilibrium spectral exponent, not stochastic extinction, biomass optimization, or far-field recovery.
title: A sharp RMS recovery ceiling and graph-equitable attainability in dispersive logistic populations
